name: wonder-pill
tagline_zh: 你抛来一个开放话题，它不急着答，而是拆出你话里藏着的假设，反转成扎人的「如果…」，再长成一张能存能传的思维导图。
tagline_en: Feed it an open topic—it digs out hidden assumptions, flips them into sharp what-ifs, and grows a shareable mind.
desc_en: Turns open-ended requests into things to think WITH instead of answers to accept. Audits the hidden assumptions inside a topic, inverts them into sharp "what if" provocations, branches each one outward, and delivers a fully-expanded mind map image plus the written wonderings. Fire this when the person signals they want to open up a space and think alongside you — "wonder about X", "what are the we
why_zh: 它把「想清楚」变成可操作的动作：先审计假设，再反转成挑衅，最后分支展开。不是替你思考。
why_en: It operationalizes 'thinking clearly': audit assumptions, invert into provocations, branch outward. Not a thinker for you—a.
limit_zh: 只处理开放型话题；若你问的是「怎么修漏水的水龙头」这类要答案的问题，它会拒绝并提醒你换个工具。
limit_en: Only for open-ended topics; if you ask 'how to fix a leaky faucet,' it refuses and points you elsewhere. Output is a mind-map image plus text—it.
